faqs.q: Sec. 86-81. - Fiscal management; custody of funds.
faqs.a:
The board shall be the trustee of the pension fund, and the treasurer shall be the
               custodian of the pension fund. The treasurer shall keep a separate account thereof,
               which shall at all times show the true condition of such fund. The treasurer, upon
               the expiration of his term of office, shall surrender and deliver to his successor
               all bonds and unexpired moneys or other property which may have come into his hands
               as treasurer of said fund.
(Code 1960, § 19-19(A); Code 1981, § 26-37)
